# N12 intrinsic time-quotient force root

Status: `FORCE_ROOT_INTRINSIC_QUOTIENT_EQUIVALENCE_DERIVED`.

Let `C(y)=0` be one regular event-child reset stratum, with tangent
`T=ker D C(y)`, and let `G=span{g_tau}` be the exact coupled whole-system
time-translation orbit.  The physical tangent is `T/G`.  The replacement
functional

`Gamma_rep=Gamma_heat-Gamma_SM^zeta`

is invariant under the same exact time translation.  Its covector therefore
annihilates the orbit generator:

`q_rep(g_tau)=0`.

Consequently `q_rep|T` is basic and descends uniquely to a covector on
`T/G`.  Its quotient value is zero if and only if its pullback vanishes on
all of `T`:

`[q_rep]=0 on T/G  <=>  q_rep(v)=0 for every v in ker D C`.

For a finite-dimensional regular constraint Jacobian this is equivalent to

`q_rep in range(D C^dagger)`,

or to the raw bordered KKT multiplier equation

`q_rep+D C^dagger delta_lambda=0`.

Thus the existing raw-nullspace and bordered-KKT force-root tests are not
merely witnesses: once the actual action-owned `q_rep` is supplied, they are
intrinsically equivalent to the physical time-quotient root condition.  No
orthogonal projection of the child flow and no chosen phase slice is needed
for the first-force root.

This theorem does not identify the missing maximal-child operator or evaluate
`q_rep`.  Nor does it remove the quotient from the Hessian spectrum: a mode
classification must still work intrinsically on `T/G` or exhibit a valid
bordered gauge realization.  The physical common-scale center is retained;
only exact coupled time translation is quotiented.

No reset representative, endpoint, selector, scale, fit, action term, time
direction, gate, or chord is added.  Gate 7 remains active.
